deal.product_description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra is a premium 47mm LTE Titanium smartwatch designed for both style and functionality. It features a circular display made with durable materials suitable for outdoor activities, providing GPS tracking, health monitoring, and custom apps for various needs. The robust design integrates a range of smart features including notifications, music control, and heart rate tracking, making it an ideal companion for fitness enthusiasts and tech-savvy users alike.

The Refurbished Unlocked Apple iPhone 14 Pro Max offers an impressive 256GB storage and a huge display, perfect for both media consumption and productivity. Enjoy advanced camera technology for stunning photos. This model is designed to provide a seamless user experience with 5G capabilities for faster downloads and streaming. Refurbished to high standards, it comes in various colors and can support all the latest apps from the App Store, accommodating any Apple enthusiast's needs.

Apple Mac mini (2024) with the M4 chip is a compact desktop featuring Apple Intelligence, 16GB of unified RAM, and a 256GB SSD. It runs macOS and provides a small-footprint workstation suitable for general productivity, media tasks, and light creative work, offering modern Apple silicon performance in a mini tower design.
Refurbished Apple 7th‑Generation iPad 10.2" 32GB Wi‑Fi (2019 model MW742LL/A) with 1-year Allstate warranty for $99, estimated true value ~$187.54.

Anker SOLIX F2000 Portable Power Station (Model A1780) – high-capacity, HyperFlash rapid-charging power station with 3x USB-C, 2x USB-A, and 2x 12V car outlets, ideal for camping, emergency backup, and mobile work setups.

The Abok (Ark3600) portable solar generator packs a 3,840Wh LiFePO4 battery with 3,600W continuous output and 4,500W surge capacity, suitable for running essential household appliances, RVs, or job-site tools. It includes a 400W foldable solar panel for off-grid recharging, offers 15 output ports including an RV 30A outlet, UPS backup functionality, and expandable battery capability up to 11,520Wh. Designed for long-term backup use, it balances high capacity and multiple outputs for whole-home or mobile power needs.

Dell 14 Plus Ultra 7 258V is a 14-inch ultraportable laptop built around Intel's Core Ultra 7 155H (Lunar Lake) 8-core processor. It features a 14.0" 2560×1600 IPS display, 32GB of RAM, and a 1TB NVMe SSD, and runs Windows 11 Home with Copilot+ PC integration. The combination of high memory capacity, large fast storage, and a high-resolution screen makes it suited for content creation, multitasking, and productivity on the go.

OneAir Elite Lifetime Subscription provides long-term monitoring of hotel and flight prices and issues refunds or rebookings when prices drop after purchase. The lifetime plan grants access to the service’s price-drop protections and booking-monitor features intended for frequent travelers who want continuous savings intelligence without recurring fees.

Linksys Multi-Gig Micro Mesh Wi‑Fi 6 System is a compact mesh networking kit that delivers multi-gigabit wired backhaul and Wi‑Fi 6 wireless speeds for whole-home coverage. Designed for users needing strong throughput for many devices, it supports modern Wi‑Fi standards, easy setup, and improved latency and bandwidth for streaming, gaming, and smart-home devices.

Unlocked Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra Android smartphone with a 1TB storage option, Titanium Black color and a powerful Snapdragon 8 Elite processor, featuring a 6.9" QHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display and a 5,000mAh battery for all‑carrier use.
Refurb iRobot Roomba Combo i5+ Self-Emptying Robot Vacuum combines automated cleaning with self-emptying technology and smart home compatibility, backed by a warranty.
